records.name: Emergency Measures
records.objectives_text: Bloodguard Lorga wants you to go to the Gimorak's Den to the east and obtain 6 Worg Furs.

records.name: Forging Hodir's Spear
records.objectives_text: Lorekeeper Randvir in Dun Niffelem wants you to collect 3 Everfrost Shards from the depths of Hibernal Cavern and 3 Stoic Mammoth Hides from the Stoic Mammoth in the Valley of Ancient Winters.

records.name: How To Slay Your Dragon
records.objectives_text: You are to use Hodir's Spear to challenge a Wild Wyrm in the Valley of Ancient Winters. Once in its grip, you are to fight to the death.

records.name: The Earthen Oath
records.objectives_text: Thorim, at the Terrace of the Makers, wants you to use the Horn of the Peaks and call on the Earthen to defeat 20 Iron Dwarves and 7 Iron Sentinels.

records.name: A Viscous Cleaning
records.objectives_text: You are to enter Hibernal Cavern west of Dun Niffelem and collect 5 units of Viscous Oil from the Viscous Oils there. You are then to return to Dun Niffelem and apply the oil to Hodir's Helm.

records.name: The Iron Colossus
records.objectives_text: Use a Tamed Jormungar to defeat the Iron Colossus and return to Bouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge.

records.name: Scourge Tactics
records.objectives_text: Crusade Commander Entari at the Argent Vanguard in Icecrown has asked that you free 8 Webbed Crusaders.

records.name: A New Beginning
records.objectives_text: Njormeld wants you to take the Reforged Armor to Thorim at the Temple of Storms.

records.name: Krolmir, Hammer of Storms
records.objectives_text: Thorim wants you to talk to King Jokkum in Dun Niffelem and discover what he knows of Krolmir.

records.name: Culling Jorcuttar
records.objectives_text: King Jokkum in Dun Niffelem wants you to slay Jorcuttar in Hibernal Cavern.

records.name: The Witness and the Hero
records.objectives_text: Xarantaur, at Camp Tunka'lo, wants you to read the First History Scroll, the Second History Scroll, and the Third History Scroll.

records.name: Loken's Lackeys
records.objectives_text: Thorim wants you to slay Eisenfaust inside the Hall of the Shaper and Halefnir the Windborn and Duronn the Runeforged in the Terrace of the Makers.

records.name: Honor Above All Else
records.objectives_text: Report to Crusade Commander Entari at the Argent Vanguard in Icecrown.

records.name: Memories of Stormhoof
records.objectives_text: Speak with Chieftain Swiftspear in Frostfloe Deep, then return to Xarantaur at Camp Tunka'lo.

objectives.text: Ask Chieftain Swiftspear about his memories

records.name: Distortions in Time
records.objectives_text: Use the Chieftain's Totem to close 4 Frostfloe Rifts, then bring the totem to Xarantaur at Camp Tunka'lo.

records.name: Defending The Vanguard
records.objectives_text: Crusader Lord Dalfors at the Argent Vanguard in Icecrown has asked that you kill 15 Forgotten Depths Nerubians.

records.name: Curing The Incurable
records.objectives_text: Father Gustav at the Argent Vanguard in Icecrown has asked that you bring him 10 Forgotten Depths Venom Sacs.

records.name: Finish the Shipment
records.objectives_text: Bring a Chalcedony to Timothy Jones in Dalaran.

records.name: Deep in the Bowels of The Underhalls
records.objectives_text: The Bone Witch in Njorndar Village has asked you to beat information out of Apprentice Osterkilgr concerning the whereabouts of Dr. Terrible. You are then to slay the apprentice.

objectives.text: Information beaten out of Apprentice Osterkilgr

wiki.page: Deep in the Bowels of The Underhalls

records.name: The Sum is Greater than the Parts

start.name: Dr. Terrible's "Building a Better Flesh Giant"
start.page: Dr. Terrible's "Building a Better Flesh Giant"

records.objectives_text: Mount and take control of Nergeld. Defend it from the denizens of the Hall of Horrors until Dr. Terrible shows himself. Use Nergeld to slay the doctor, and then return to The Bone Witch in Njorndar Village.

wiki.page: The Sum is Greater than the Parts

records.name: If There Are Survivors...
records.objectives_text: Speak with Penumbrius at the Argent Vanguard in Icecrown.

records.name: Into The Wild Green Yonder
records.objectives_text: Rescue 3 Captured Argent Crusaders from Scourgeholme and drop them off at the Vanguard Infirmary at the center of the Argent Vanguard. Report to Highlord Tirion Fordring should you succeed.

records.name: Feeding Arngrim
records.objectives_text: You are to feed Arngrim 5 Disembodied Jormungar, then return to Arngrim's frozen image in Dun Niffelem. You must go to the Valley of Ancient Winters and use Arngrim's Tooth on the Roaming Jormungar there. Once they have become disembodied, you must fight them until they are weakened.

records.name: The Reckoning
records.objectives_text: Meet Thorim near the Temple of Wisdom. Report the outcome of the fight to Jokkum in Dun Niffelem.

prerequisites.wiki_text: Loken's Lackeys and The Earthen Oath

records.name: Where Time Went Wrong
records.objectives_text: Use the Lorehammer on Taunka Relics to attune it to the time of Stormhoof. Once it has been attuned to 6 relics from the time of Stormhoof, return to Xarantaur at Camp Tunka'lo.

records.name: The Hero's Arms
records.objectives_text: Recover Stormhoof's Spear and Stormhoof's Mail and return them to Xarantaur at Camp Tunka'lo.

records.name: Veranus
records.objectives_text: Thorim, at the Temple of Storms, wants you to obtain 5 Small Proto-Drake Eggs from the peaks near Brunnhildar Village.

records.name: Territorial Trespass
records.objectives_text: Place the Stolen Proto-Dragon Eggs on top of the Broodmother's Nest and return to Thorim at the Temple of Storms.

records.name: The Missing Tracker
records.objectives_text: Look for Tracker Val'zij inside Gimorak's Den, southeast of the Grom'arsh Crash Site.

records.name: Cave Medicine
records.objectives_text: Tracker Val'zij, at Gimorak's Den, wants you to obtain 1 Jormungar Toxin Gland and 8 Cave Mushrooms.

records.name: There's Always Time for Revenge
records.objectives_text: Tracker Val'zij wants you to slay Gimorak inside Gimorak's Den.

records.name: The Terrace of the Makers
records.objectives_text: Find Thorim at the southeastern edge of the Terrace of the Makers, just northwest of Dun Niffelem.

records.name: Changing the Wind's Course
records.objectives_text: Use the Lorehammer to travel back in time and face the North Wind as Stormhoof. When Stormhoof falls and drops the :Horn of Elemental Fury, recover it, finish off the North Wind, and then return to Xarantaur at Camp Tunka'lo.

records.name: When All Else Fails
records.objectives_text: Speak to Ricket to make use of Ricket's D16 Propelled Delivery Device to enter further into Storm Peaks.

records.name: Prepare for Glory
records.objectives_text: Speak to Lok'lira the Crone in Brunnhildar Village.

records.name: Lok'lira's Parting Gift
records.objectives_text: Speak to Gretta the Arbiter in Brunnhildar Village.

records.name: Deemed Worthy
records.objectives_text: Brijana wants you to go to Brunnhildar Village and speak with Astrid Bjornrittar.

records.name: Sibling Rivalry
records.objectives_text: Thorim wants you to listen to his story.

records.name: A Tale of Valor
records.objectives_text: Highlord Tirion Fordring at Crusaders' Pinnacle has requested that you locate the hero, Crusader Bridenbrad at the Silent Vigil, in northeast Icecrown. His fire pit will likely be the most obvious indication of his location from the air.

records.name: Shoot 'Em Up
records.objectives_text: The Leaper at The Shadow Vault wants you to use a Jotunheim Rapid-Fire Harpoon to shoot down 20 Jotunheim Proto-Drakes and their riders.

objectives.text: Jotunheim Proto-Drakes & their riders shot down (20)

records.name: A Cold Front Approaches
records.objectives_text: Report to Siegemaster Fezzik at the Argent Vanguard in Icecrown.

records.name: Vile Like Fire!
records.objectives_text: Vile at The Shadow Vault wants you to steal a Njorndar Proto-Drake and use it to set fire to 10 vrykul buildings in the greater Jotunheim region. Balargarde Fortress, due to its nature, cannot be set ablaze.

records.name: A Hero Remains
records.objectives_text: Bring news of Crusader Bridenbrad's fate to Highlord Tirion Fordring at Crusaders' Pinnacle.

records.name: The Keeper's Favor
records.objectives_text: Highlord Tirion Fordring at Crusaders' Pinnacle has requested that you secure passage from Arch Druid Lilliandra and speak to Keeper Remulos in Moonglade.

records.name: Hope Within the Emerald Nightmare
records.objectives_text: Keeper Remulos at Moonglade has instructed you to enter the emerald dream and recover 3 Emerald Acorns. Leave the vicinity of the Shrine of Remulos to return to Azeroth.

records.name: The Boon of Remulos
records.objectives_text: Return to Crusader Bridenbrad in Icecrown with the Emerald Acorn.

records.name: Time Yet Remains
records.objectives_text: Return to Highlord Tirion Fordring at Crusaders' Pinnacle with news of :Emerald Acorn's effects.

records.name: The Touch of an Aspect
records.objectives_text: Request the aid of Alexstrasza the Life-Binder at Wyrmrest Temple.

records.name: Dahlia's Tears
records.objectives_text: Alexstrasza the Life-Binder at Wyrmrest Temple has requested that you recover Dahlia's Tears from soil freshly cleansed by a Ruby Keeper's flames.

records.name: The Boon of Alexstrasza
records.objectives_text: Bring the Breath of Alexstrasza to Crusader Bridenbrad in Icecrown.

records.name: Hope Yet Remains
records.objectives_text: Return to Highlord Tirion Fordring at Crusaders' Pinnacle with news of the effects of the Breath of Alexstrasza.

records.name: The Will of the Naaru
records.objectives_text: Request the aid of A'dal in Shattrath City.

records.name: The Boon of A'dal
records.objectives_text: Return to Crusader Bridenbrad at the Silent Vigil in Icecrown.

records.name: Light Within the Darkness
records.objectives_text: Bring Crusader Bridenbrad's Tabard to Highlord Tirion Fordring at Crusaders' Pinnacle.

records.name: Vandalizing Jotunheim
records.objectives_text: Duke Lankral at The Shadow Vault wants you to burn 10 Vrykul Banners.

records.name: Vaelen Has Returned
records.objectives_text: Speak with Vaelen the Flayed at The Shadow Vault.

records.name: The Last Line Of Defense
records.objectives_text: Use an Argent Cannon to destroy 100 Scourge Attackers. You must also kill 3 Frostbrood Destroyers. Return to Siegemaster Fezzik should you succeed.

records.name: Northern Cooking
records.objectives_text: Bring four chilled meat to Brom Brewbaster at Valgarde. Chilled meat can be found on any Northrend beast.

records.name: Northern Cooking
records.objectives_text: Bring four chilled meat to Rollick MacKreel at Valiance Keep. Chilled meat can be found on any Northrend beast.

records.objectives_text: Bring four chilled meat to Thomas Kolichio at Vengeance Landing. Chilled meat can be found on any Northrend beast.

records.name: Northern Cooking
records.objectives_text: Bring four chilled meat to Orn Tenderhoof at Warsong Hold. Chilled meat can be found on any Northrend beast.

records.objectives_text: The Bone Witch in Njorndar Village wants you to possess a Water Terror and use it to slay 10 vrykul in the greater Jotunheim region. Qualifying vrykul are Jotunheim Sleep-Watchers, Jotunheim Warriors, Mjordin Water Magi, Njorndar Spear-Sisters, and Valhalas Vargul.

records.objectives_text: The Bone Witch in Njorndar Village has instructed you to collect 15 Vrykul Bones.

records.objectives_text: Use your Meatloaf Pan to cook 4 Infused Mushrooms and 2 Chilled Meats and bring the finished Mushroom Meatloaf to Orton Bennet in Curiosities & Moore, located in Runeweaver Square in Dalaran.

variants.name: Sewer Stew
variants.objectives_text: Cook 4 Crystalsong Carrots from Crystalsong Forest with 4 Chilled Meat in the Cookpot. Then bring the Vegetable Stew to the Dalaran sewers Innkeeper Ajay Green.

records.name: Convention at the Legerdemain
records.objectives_text: Bring 4 Northern Stew that you use your cooking skill to make and a Jug of Wine from the cheese shop in Dalaran to Arille Azuregaze at the Legerdemain Lounge found in Runeweaver Square in Dalaran.

records.name: Sewer Stew
records.objectives_text: Cook 4 Crystalsong Carrot from Crystalsong Forest with 4 Chilled Meat in the Cookpot. Once it is ready bring the Vegetable Stew to the Dalaran sewers Innkeeper Ajay Green.

records.name: Once More Unto The Breach, Hero
records.objectives_text: Report to the Ebon Watcher in the Valley of Echoes just outside the Breach.

wiki.page: Once More Unto The Breach, Hero

records.name: Blackwatch
records.objectives_text: Speak to Darkrider Arly at Blackwatch.

records.name: Mustard Dogs!
records.objectives_text: Fill the Empty Picnic Basket with 4 Rhino Dogs that you use your Cooking skill to make and 4 Wild Mustard that you find in the grassy areas of Dalaran. Bring the Picnic Basket to Archmage Pentarus at Krasus' Landing in Dalaran.

records.name: The Restless Dead
records.objectives_text: Father Gustav at the Valley of Echoes in Icecrown wants you to use Holy Water on the corpses of Reanimated Crusaders to free 10 restless souls.

records.objectives_text: Cook 4 Infused Mushrooms from the Dalaran sewers with 2 Chilled Meats in your Meatloaf Pan and bring them to Orton Bennet in Curiosities & Moore located in Runeweaver Square in Dalaran.

records.name: Convention at the Legerdemain
records.objectives_text: Bring 4 Northrend Stews and a Jug of Wine from the cheese shop in Dalaran to Arrille Azuregaze at the Legerdemain Lounge found in Runeweaver Square in Dalaran.

records.name: Cheese for Glowergold
records.objectives_text: Combine the empty cheese platter with Aged Dalaran Limburger from the cheese shop "One More Glass" and with 6 Half Full Dalaran Wine Glasses found on tables around Dalaran. Bring the Wine and Cheese platter to Ranid Glowergold at the Leatherworkers in the Magus Commerce Exchange.

variants.name: Cheese for Glowergold
variants.objectives_text: Combine the empty cheese platter with Aged Dalaran Limburger from the cheese shop "One More Glass" and with 6 Half Full Dalaran Wine Glasses found on tables around Dalaran. records.name: Mustard Dogs!
records.objectives_text: Fill the Empty Picnic Basket with 4 Rhino Dogs that you be cookin' with your skill and 4 Wild Mustard that you find in the grassy areas of Dalaran. Bring the Picnic Basket to Archmage Pentarus at Krasus' Landing in Dalaran.

records.name: Where Are They Coming From?
records.objectives_text: Investigate a Summoning Altar in the eastern part of the Fleshwerks, then report back to Darkrider Arly at Blackwatch.

records.name: The Purging Of Scourgeholme
records.objectives_text: The Ebon Watcher at the Valley of Echoes in Icecrown wants you to kill 3 Forgotten Depths High Priests, 3 Forgotten Depths Underkings, and 8 Reanimated Crusaders.

records.name: Destroying the Altars
records.objectives_text: Kill Master Summoner Zarod and use his :Master Summoner's Staff to destroy the First, Second, Third, and Fourth Summoning Altars. When you've completed this task, report to Darkrider Arly at Blackwatch.

records.name: Death's Gaze
records.objectives_text: Use the Death's Gaze Orb to place orbs on the Abomination Lab Orb Stand, the Flesh Giant Lab Orb Stand, and the Cauldron Area Orb Stand, then return to Darkrider Arly at Blackwatch.

objectives.text: Orb placed in flesh giant lab

records.name: Through the Eye
records.objectives_text: The Bone Witch in Njorndar Village has tasked you with using the Eye of the Lich King to gain information.

objectives.text: Information gained for The Bone Witch

records.name: The Scourgestone
records.objectives_text: The Ebon Watcher at the Valley of Echoes in Icecrown wants you to bring him 15 Scourgestones.

records.name: The Struggle Persists
records.objectives_text: Raelorasz wants you to enter the Oculus and rescue Belgaristrasz and his companions.

records.name: The Air Stands Still
records.objectives_text: The Ebon Watcher at the Valley of Echoes in Icecrown wants you to kill Salranax the Flesh Render, Underking Talonox and High Priest Yath'amon.

prerequisites.wiki_text: The Purging Of Scourgeholme The Scourgestone

records.objectives_text: Belgaristrasz wants you to destroy 10 Centrifuge Constructs to bring down Varos' shield. You then must defeat Varos Cloudstrider.

records.name: Mage-Lord Urom
records.objectives_text: Belgaristrasz wants you to defeat Mage-Lord Urom in the Oculus.

records.name: A Wing and a Prayer
records.objectives_text: Belgaristrasz wants you to kill Eregos in the Oculus and then report to Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield in Coldarra.

records.name: Head Games
records.objectives_text: Kurzel wants you to use Kurzel's Blouse Scrap at the corpse of Novos the Summoner, then take the Ichor-Stained Cloth to her inside Drak'Tharon Keep.

records.objectives_text: Crusade Architect Silas at the Valley of Echoes in Icecrown wants you to retrieve 10 Trunks of Crystalline Heartwood and 10 pieces of Ancient Elven Masonry.

wiki.page: The Stone That Started A Revolution

records.objectives_text: Brigg in Utgarde Pinnacle wants you to find 5 Untarnished Silver Bars, 3 Shiny Baubles, 2 Golden Goblets, and a Jade Statue.

records.name: Vengeance Be Mine!
records.objectives_text: Brigg in Utgarde Pinnacle wants you to kill King Ymiron.

records.objectives_text: The Bone Witch at Njorndar Village wants you to return with Iskalder.

objectives.text: Iskalder delivered to The Bone Witch

records.objectives_text: Darkrider Arly at Blackwatch wants you to destroy 5 vats of Embalming Fluid and 5 Blood Orbs.

records.objectives_text: Crusade Engineer Spitzpatrick at the Valley of Echoes in Icecrown wants you to retrieve 8 pieces of Crystallized Energy.

records.name: Jagged Shards
records.objectives_text: Bring 10 Jagged Shards to Crusader Olakin Sainrith at Blackwatch.

records.objectives_text: The Bone Witch in Njorndar Village wants you to defeat Iskalder upon Battlescar Spire. Suggested Players [5]

records.name: I'm Smelting... Smelting!
records.objectives_text: Use the Bag of Jagged Shards near one of the Malykriss furnaces. Return to Crusader Olakin Sainrith at Blackwatch with the Smelted Metal Bar.

records.objectives_text: Deliver Father Gustav's Report to Highlord Tirion Fordring at the Argent Vanguard in Icecrown.

records.objectives_text: Bring 5 Runed Saronite Plates to Crusader Olakin Sainrith at Blackwatch.

records.name: The Battle For Crusaders' Pinnacle
records.objectives_text: Venture to Crusaders' Pinnacle and use the Blessed Banner of the Crusade atop the Pile of Crusader Skulls. Defend the banner against Scourge attack until the land atop the pinnacle is sanctified and then return to Father Gustav at the Valley of Echoes in Icecrown.

records.name: Banshee's Revenge
records.objectives_text: The Bone Witch at Njorndar Village has asked you to exact her revenge by challenging and defeating Overthane Balargarde. Suggested Players [5]

records.objectives_text: Vereth the Cunning on the Rise of Suffering has requested that you bring a subdued Lithe Stalker to the top of the rocks northeast of the Rise of Suffering.

records.objectives_text: Darkrider Arly at Blackwatch wants you to destroy 3 Chained Abominations with Burning Skeletons.

prerequisites.wiki_text: A Visit to the Doctor & By Fire Be Purged

records.objectives_text: Vereth the Cunning at the Rise of Suffering has requested that you use a Lithe Stalker to scout out Malykriss.

records.objectives_text: Vereth the Cunning wants you to use the Lithe Stalker's Iron Chain to drag Scourge Bombs to 4 Lumbering Atrocities inside Malykriss.

records.objectives_text: Vereth the Cunning at the Rise of Suffering wants you to use a Lithe Stalker to throw rocks at Umbral Brutes as they near lesser undead in Malykriss. Return after you've started 5 fights.

records.objectives_text: Chromie wants you to use the Arcane Disruptor on the suspicious crate in Stratholme Past, then speak to her near the entrance to Stratholme.

records.objectives_text: Chromie has asked you to accompany Arthas in the Culling of Stratholme. You are to speak with her again after Mal'Ganis is defeated.

records.objectives_text: Darkrider Arly at Blackwatch wants you to destroy the Metal Stake imprisoning Patches in the Sanctum of Reanimation and help him get his revenge on Doctor Sabnok.

prerequisites.wiki_text: I'm Smelting... Smelting! & The Runesmiths of Malykriss
